children: stocks each gained 1.3% in Monday midday trading after Mizuho Securities upgraded both stocks amid an improving outlook for the single-family home rental, or SFR, sector.
Mizuho analyst Haendel St. Juste cites "an improved fundamental, regulatory, and growth set-up that positions SFRs ahead of other residential REIT subsectors from a growth and risk-adjusted profile."
With the passage of the 21st Century ROAD to Housing bill, Mizuho also sees sizable “roll-up” opportunities for SFR REITs to acquire smaller and mid-scale players.
The more attractive setup comes after SFR REITs have underperformed the broader RMZ index by about 1,300 basis points year to date.

Mizuho's updated estimates imply ~4% 2027 AFFO-per-share growth, compared with ~3% for apartment REITs and ~3% for manufactured housing REITs, according to St. Juste. Meanwhile, the SFR stocks are trading at ~16x price/AFFP, or ~6.5x turns below its own 10-year average, a wider discount than apartments' ~3.5x turns and manufactured housing's ~4x turns.
